title: On the number of perfect matchings in planar graphs
summary: We investigate the minimum non-zero number of perfect matchings in planar graphs. We prove that this is a constant for 2-connected planar graphs of minimum degree 3 and 3-connected planar graphs. In the former case, the constant is 4 and this is best possible. In the 3-connected case, we give several infinite families, including nearly 3-regular graphs and triangulations with a constant number of perfect matchings.
